In the following years, several sections of PA 144 were paved, including the section from Sproul State Forest to the Clinton County line in 1936 and around Cross Fork and within the Sproul State Forest in 1938. flags: Corridor length unresolved: VisitPA gives 27 miles; Renovo and South Renovo cache pages give 35 and 34 miles to Snow Shoe. Material mapped length is 31.5 miles. Omitted a precise distance.
Moments run from Renovo toward Snow Shoe, following increasing strip-map miles. Snow Shoe and Dennison Overlook remain short because their place-specific evidence is thin.
Snow Shoe naming tradition identifies no nation and supplies no underlying community account; retained as tradition, not a documented naming event.

VisitPA’s absolute claim of no visible houses or power lines was omitted because PA 144’s route description includes residential stretches. Dennison darkness figures are cached tourism claims, not a new field check.
